decisions.authority: src/mcp/tool-validation.ts validateEditArguments, called by validateToolArguments (single path)
decisions.irrelevantRejected: known schema fields that do not apply to the requested mode are rejected, not silently ignored
decisions.positionEnum: enforced by validateProperty against the registry schema enum

limitations: This verifies the boundary contract only; engine semantics (AST identity rename, per-language masking, rollback) are E2-E6.
The compiled CLI path requires a fresh build (bin/bb); the MCP path under Bun executes src/mcp/server.ts directly.
